ABOUT ME

Curious about data. Intentional about impact.

My work sits at the meeting point of data, technology, and human questions. With a background in Demography and Social Statistics, I am drawn to systems that turn information into clearer, more useful decisions.

Through the TAG AI Ecosystem, I have explored NLP, retrieval-augmented generation, and agent-oriented product thinking. I am especially interested in AI that is practical, transparent, and built with care.

Beyond technical work, I value learning in community and supporting others as they grow.
